description:
The US Treasury Department threatened damaging new sanctions on countries that refuse to cut economic ties with Iran — but stopped short of actually imposing big new penalties.

“We find that the best way to engage with countries is through quiet diplomacy, and we are level-setting with every country to tell them our expectations,” Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said. “We know who they are. They know who they are.”

CNN spoke with experts to on their first reactions to Bessent’s announcement: economist Justin Wolfers and Retired Colonel Cedric Leighton.

author: CNN
description:
The United States and Canada are barreling toward a deeper trade war after last-ditch efforts to strike a deal collapsed Friday. The failed efforts resulted in President Donald Trump enacting 50% tariffs on roughly $20 billion worth of Canadian goods early Saturday morning. Canada is preparing to retaliate with “dollar-for-dollar” tariffs starting September 8, Prime Minister Mark Carney announced over the weekend.

On Monday, Trump escalated matters further, threatening to double duties charged on Canadian cars and car parts to 50% come January 1. “Canada has been ripping off the United States of America for years,” Trump said in a Truth Social post. “Not sustainable, and NOT ANYMORE!”

0:00 Canada ends US trade talks, will start retaliatory tariffs Sept. 8

4:26 British Columbia premier David Eby: Trump is making US "a global pariah"
9:15 CNN global economic analyst Rana Foroohar breaks down which country
title: Trump enacts 50% tariffs on some Canadian goods; Canada set to retaliate

author: CNN
description:
A wildfire threatening neighborhoods in and around Reno, Nevada, has forced officials to urge around 90,000 people to evacuate and cancel school for much of the area on Monday – and high winds that have frustrated firefighters’ efforts to contain it could make the situation more dire this week.

The uncontained Hawk Fire – which started Saturday and had burned some 15,000 acres northwest of Reno by Sunday – was human-caused, officials have said, without saying how it started or whether it was intentionally set. Flames could be seen rapidly Sunday advancing down a hillside toward residential neighborhoods near Reno, marking the latest in a destructive fire season that has scorched thousands of acres and forced the evacuations of entire towns across the Southwest.

author: CNN
description:
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has warned in an op-ed that an “economic D-Day” is coming for Iran, stopping short of giving further details. “Now we are entering the endgame. At dawn begins an economic D-Day — the single greatest financial offensive ever marshalled against an adversary,” he wrote in the Financial Times ahead of a scheduled news conference today.

The US has been imposing sanctions on Iran since 1979, after the US embassy in Tehran was seized following the Iranian Revolution, according to the US State Department.
